summary: Segmented DateField and TimeField inputs with bound values, minute granularity and 24h and 12h hour cycles.
use: Typing a date or time directly in a form, such as a birthday or an appointment start time.
spec: `<DateField label="Birthday" locale="en-US" bind:value={birthday} />` initialised with `new CalendarDate(2026, 10, 10)`
`<TimeField label="Time (24h)" locale="en-US" hourCycle={24} bind:value={time} />` initialised with `new Time(14, 30)`
